_about: Shown once on each phone after it installs a new Android update (not on a first install). Replace the list with what this update changes, in plain words, each time an Android update is approved and built.
items: Notes for this check in the Manifest check, for things like a DC that didn’t send a manifest. They stay on the phone until you tap Clear, and go on the Excel and PDF of the check (under Delivery Details) and in the shared missing list.
